_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's choices, 12-13 Nov 2026). OBJECTIVES: 1,050 EUR by 13 Nov 12:00 Paris time, +10% overall; winning trades of 20 EUR or more. Hence: 2% of equity (about 20 EUR) risked per trade, positions up to 100% of equity each, simulated 3x leverage, new strategies deployed only when their target is at least 4x their stop. Validated strategies only (exploration switched OFF on 13 Nov), no forward test, research every 6 hours.
